supportingReference.role: Reused evidence board only; this task owns a new pipeline state and inherits no prior pass decisions. The board introduces no geometry, color, material, or state claims beyond the two authoritative concept images.

objectClass.notes: The closed concept is authoritative for outer silhouette, cloth, brass plate, page block, and fore-edge ribbon. The open journal concept is authoritative for the two page stacks, gutter, page crown, rules, paper fiber, open cover lip, and ribbon through the gutter. The hidden rear cover is a consistency inference: match the front cover's cloth wrap, thickness, corner radius, and edge construction, but omit the front nameplate and rivets.

reasoning: The closed object reads as a compact rounded volume, but opening it reveals two independent cover/page sides, a center hinge, and a continuous bookmark path.
Identity depends on repeated page-edge strata, faint ruled lines, two brass fasteners, and multi-band cloth/paper/ribbon relief rather than on a few primitive solids.
The front cover must rotate around the existing spine-side hinge while the root and interaction coordinates remain stable, so pivot placement is a fidelity and runtime requirement.
The rear exterior is not directly shown; symmetry and matching bookbinding construction are sufficient only for a stylized consistency inference, not an observed claim.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Closed and open states must share one stable hierarchy with named cover/page pivots, separate left/right page stacks, repeated page and rule systems, and independent cloth, paper, brass, and ribbon responses.

detailInventory.note: All detail claims come from the authoritative closed/open concepts. The neutral board only groups those crops. Hidden rear-cover treatment is explicitly marked as a consistency inference.

definitionOfDone: Closed state matches the compact rounded moss-cloth silhouette, recessed ivory page block, convex spine, blank aged-brass plate with two domed rivets, and burgundy V-notched tail.

Open state approaches 180 degrees around a stable spine-side cover pivot and presents separate left/right page stacks, a readable V-shaped gutter, broad page crowns, layered outer edges, and a narrow cloth cover lip.
One ribbon path remains attached at the spine and transitions coherently between closed fore-edge and open gutter poses without page intersection or teleporting endpoints.
Cloth, paper, brass, and ribbon use independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO evidence; woven/fibrous/metallic responses remain readable under neutral and grazing light.
Overall AI-vision fidelity is at least 0.85 and every critical semantic feature scores at least 0.82 from a matched reference/render comparison.

featureGroups.name: Closed clothbound book silhouette
qualityCriteria: Cover width:depth is approximately 0.84 and total closed thickness remains about 10 percent of depth.
Broad plan-view corner arcs, cover overhang, bowed page fore-edge, and convex spine read without materials.
failureModes: thin-axis radius clamping produces nearly square corners
page block is flush with the cover or reads as one plastic slab

featureGroups.name: Open two-sided page and cover structure
qualityCriteria: Left and right covers/pages are independently named and attached around the spine, not mirrored cards with no binding volume.
Open spread includes two page-stack volumes, broad top-page crowns, staggered outer leaf edges, and a narrow recessed gutter.
failureModes: left page stack disappears when front cover opens
gutter is a painted line or a wide gap

featureGroups.name: Stable root, hinge, and state pivots
qualityCriteria: Root stays centered at the existing notebook local origin while the front-cover pivot remains at local [-1.5, 0.3, 0].
Front assembly rotates to 0.97π about local Z; page/cover children retain local attachment and do not orbit from their centers.
failureModes: root or hit area shifts between states
child transforms mix local and world coordinates

featureGroups.name: Spine, gutter, and continuous ribbon binding system
qualityCriteria: Convex spine shoulders, the open gutter valley, and the padded cloth dip communicate one binding construction.
Ribbon spline has a spine socket, closed and open state control points, surface clearance, and a real V-notched terminal.
failureModes: ribbon floats, intersects pages, or changes identity between states
spine and gutter do not align
tail ends as an unmodified box

featureGroups.name: Blank aged-brass nameplate and rivets
qualityCriteria: Thin rounded plate uses a true chamfer and remains blank.
Exactly two raised domed rivets are symmetrically spaced and cast contact shadows; face patina and edge polish use separate roughness masks.
failureModes: plate is an inset rectangle inside another plate
rivets are absent, flat decals, or incorrect in count

featureGroups.name: Cloth, paper, brass, and ribbon PBR separation
qualityCriteria: Moss cloth has directional weave normal/roughness, compressed edge variation, and no glossy plastic response.
Paper has ivory fiber breakup, warmer edge masks, high roughness, subtle subsurface-like softness, and readable layer AO.
Brass has metallic response, mottled face roughness, lower-roughness chamfer/rivet crowns, and controlled warm highlights.
Ribbon uses burgundy grosgrain ribbing and fibrous roughness distinct from cover cloth.
failureModes: one albedo map is reused for unrelated PBR channels
materials are distinguished only by flat color
micro relief disappears under grazing light

visualDeltaChecks: closed cover width/depth/thickness, corner radius, spine curvature, and page-block inset delta
open left/right stack volume, page crown, outer-edge fan, gutter width/depth, and cloth-lip delta
front-cover hinge origin and 0.97π open-state transform delta
nameplate size/placement/chamfer and two-rivet spacing/height delta
ribbon anchor, centerline path, page clearance, width, and V-notch silhouette delta
cloth weave direction/scale, paper fiber/edge warmth, brass metallic roughness, and ribbon ribbing delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not implement a cover or page with RoundedBoxGeometry when its radius is clamped by the thin axis; use plan-view shape extrusion or deformed indexed geometry.
Do not collapse the left and right page stacks, top pages, gutter, covers, spine, plate, rivets, or ribbon into one inert mesh.
Do not infer a decorated back cover: hidden rear geometry must be labeled consistency inference and must omit unobserved plate, logo, text, straps, or hardware.
Do not accept a page block represented by one smooth slab; grouped leaf layers and edge offsets must remain visible in closed and open review views.
Do not accept a flat open spread; both top pages require spline crown geometry and a recessed center gutter.
Do not accept a ribbon without a spine socket, state control points, page clearance, and V-notched end geometry.
Do not pass material look-dev when cloth, paper, brass, or ribbon aliases albedo into roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass any visual stage below 0.85 overall or below 0.82 for any critical semantic feature.

authoringInstruction: Generate one shared action-ready notebook hierarchy for closed and open states. Preserve the existing app root and front-cover hinge contract; treat the back exterior as undecorated consistency inference.
